schema: CREATE TABLE regions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region_name TEXT); CREATE TABLE tickets (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region_id INTEGER, priority INTEGER, status TEXT, category TEXT, primary_agent_code INTEGER, secondary_agent_code INTEGER, reviewer_agent_code INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (region_id) REFERENCES regions(id)); CREATE TABLE agents (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, agent_code INTEGER, badge_id INTEGER UNIQUE, rating INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT r.region_name FROM regions AS r INNER JOIN tickets AS t ON r.id = t.region_id INNER JOIN agents AS a ON t.primary_agent_code = a.agent_code GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY AVG(a.rating) DESC, r.region_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
